description: Jio offers multiple ways to check the data remaining on an active mobile plan. Users can view their balance and plan validity through the MyJio App after logging in with their mobile number and OTP. The same information is available through the Jio website under the View plan section. Users can also use JioCare on WhatsApp to request their remaining data balance. The methods work across different preferences, allowing users to choose between the app, website and messaging service.
title: How to Check Jio Data Balance and Plan Validity Using Various Methods: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: WhatsApp lets users generate individual and group chat summaries for unread messages using Meta AI. Chat summaries allow you to catch up with long message threads, which you might have missed because you were working or driving. This saves a lot of time as it eliminates the need for you to individually check all groups and individual chat windows. Apart from this, WhatsApp group chats can have multiple people messaging at the same time. Hence, an AI-generated conversation summary will help you immediately get the context of the recent messages in fewer words. WhatsApp chat summaries also help you prioritise better.
title: How to Use AI to Summarise WhatsApp Chats: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Business owners across the world, regardless of their location, size, and scale, have to frequently print, scan, and copy documents. Currently, enterprises are moving towards digitising most of their workflows. However, the physical paper documents have retained their importance. Small businesses in India, especially, have to rely on physical documents, whether they want to keep physical records of invoices, bills, regulatory compliance, or printing pamphlets for marketing purposes. Owning a printer offers great convenience to small business owners and allows them to save costs, as they do not have to pay a local printing shop in their vicinity.
title: Most Reliable Printers for Small Businesses to Buy in India From HP, Brother and More

description: Refresh rate determines how frequently a smartphone display can update its image, with 60Hz, 90Hz and 120Hz offering progressively smoother motion. The difference is most noticeable while scrolling, navigating apps and playing games that support higher frame rates. However, a higher refresh rate can also increase power consumption, while most videos do not benefit directly from faster refresh rates. Adaptive displays can switch between rates to balance smoothness and battery life. This guide explains how the three refresh rates compare and which option may suit different users.
title: 60Hz vs 90Hz vs 120Hz Displays Explained: Which Should You Choose?

description: In recent years, storage space has become one of the most influential factors behind a a new smartphone purchase. While powerful performance allows you to install and play high-end games and great cameras help capture higher-resolution photos, all of these can eat through gigabytes surprisingly quickly. At the same time, 64GB phones have largely become outdated, and 128GB usually serves as a starting point on most affordable and mid-range smartphones. Some flagships also offer 256GB as the base storage, albeit a premium price.
title: How Much Storage Do You Need on a Smartphone?

description: Vivo is all set to expand its T-series lineup in India with the upcoming T5 5G. It is expected to join other models in the brand’s mid-range lineup, which already comprises the Vivo T5 Lite 5G, T5x 5G, and T5 Pro 5G. In the days leading up to its launch, several details about the upcoming handset have been teased. The Vivo T5 5G is confirmed to sport a 1.5K 144Hz display. It will be powered by a MediaTek chipset and pack a 7,000mAh-class battery.
title: Vivo T5 Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Features, Specifications and More

description: Apple allows users to transfer their contacts from an Android phone to a new iPhone using simple steps. If you are migrating to a new iPhone from an Android handset, you can download the Move to iOS app from the Google Play Store on your Android phone to transfer the data. However, this will only work when you are setting up your new iPhone. If you have already set up your iPhone, you can choose to sync your Android phone's contacts with your Google account and log in with the same Google account on your iPhone.
title: How to Transfer Contacts From Android to iPhone: A Step-by-Step Guide
